My Spotify playlist
[アニメソング](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2h21jaELSrCkMjjNQAyTVI). The list refreshes automatically every day.

```{=html}

  }

    margin: 0 0 .25rem;

    margin: 0 0 1.1rem;

<div class="sp-wrap" id="sp-root">
  <div class="sp-hero">
    <img class="sp-cover" id="sp-cover" alt="" width="96" height="96" />
    <div class="sp-hero-text">
      <h2 id="sp-name">Playlist</h2>
      <p class="sp-meta" id="sp-meta"></p>
      <a class="sp-open" id="sp-open" href="https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2h21jaELSrCkMjjNQAyTVI" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
        Open in Spotify
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <p class="sp-now" id="sp-now">Select a song to play</p>
  <div class="sp-player">
    <div id="sp-embed"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="sp-toolbar">
    <input class="sp-search" id="sp-search" type="search" placeholder="Filter by song…" autocomplete="off" />
    <select class="sp-artist" id="sp-artist" aria-label="Filter by artist">
      <option value="">All artists</option>
    </select>
    <span class="sp-count" id="sp-count"></span>
  </div>
  <ol class="sp-list" id="sp-list"></ol>
  <p class="sp-empty" id="sp-empty" hidden>No matching songs.</p>
</div>

<script src="https://open.spotify.com/embed/iframe-api/v1" async></script>
<script>
(async () => {
  const PLAYLIST_URI = "spotify:playlist:2h21jaELSrCkMjjNQAyTVI";

  const fmtDur = (ms) => {
    const s = Math.round((ms || 0) / 1000);
    const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
    const r = s % 60;
    return `${m}:${String(r).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  };

  const splitArtists = (artists) =>
    (artists || "")
      .split(/\s*,\s*/)
      .map((name) => name.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);

  const root = document.getElementById("sp-root");
  const listEl = document.getElementById("sp-list");
  const emptyEl = document.getElementById("sp-empty");
  const countEl = document.getElementById("sp-count");
  const searchEl = document.getElementById("sp-search");
  const artistEl = document.getElementById("sp-artist");
  const embedEl = document.getElementById("sp-embed");
  const nowEl = document.getElementById("sp-now");

  let tracks = [];
  let activeId = null;
  let embedController = null;
  let embedReady = null;
  let pendingPlay = null;

  const ensureEmbed = () => {
    if (embedController) return Promise.resolve(embedController);
    if (embedReady) return embedReady;
    embedReady = new Promise((resolve) => {
      const start = (IFrameAPI) => {
        IFrameAPI.createController(
          embedEl,
          { uri: PLAYLIST_URI, width: "100%", height: 152 },
          (controller) => {
            embedController = controller;
            resolve(controller);
            if (pendingPlay) {
              const track = pendingPlay;
              pendingPlay = null;
              markActive(track);
              startUri(controller, `spotify:track:${track.id}`);
            }
          }
        );
      };
      if (window.SpotifyIframeApi) start(window.SpotifyIframeApi);
      else {
        const prev = window.onSpotifyIframeApiReady;
        window.onSpotifyIframeApiReady = (api) => {
          window.SpotifyIframeApi = api;
          if (typeof prev === "function") prev(api);
          start(api);
        };
      }
    });
    return embedReady;
  };

  const markActive = (track) => {
    activeId = track.id;
    nowEl.innerHTML = `Now playing: <strong></strong>`;
    nowEl.querySelector("strong").textContent =
      `${track.title}${track.artists ? " — " + track.artists : ""}`;
    listEl.querySelectorAll(".sp-row").forEach((row) => {
      row.classList.toggle("active", row.dataset.id === activeId);
    });
  };

  const startUri = (controller, uri) => {
    // Must stay in the same user-gesture turn as the click for autoplay.
    controller.loadUri(uri);
    controller.play();
  };

  const playTrack = (track) => {
    if (!track?.id) return;
    markActive(track);
    const uri = `spotify:track:${track.id}`;

    if (embedController) {
      startUri(embedController, uri);
      return;
    }

    // Controller still booting — queue play for the ready callback.
    pendingPlay = track;
    ensureEmbed();
  };

  // Warm up the embed API as soon as the page is ready.
  ensureEmbed();

  const populateArtists = () => {
    const counts = new Map();
    tracks.forEach((t) => {
      splitArtists(t.artists).forEach((name) => {
        counts.set(name, (counts.get(name) || 0) + 1);
      });
    });
    const names = [...counts.keys()].sort((a, b) =>
      a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { sensitivity: "base" })
    );
    artistEl.replaceChildren();
    const all = document.createElement("option");
    all.value = "";
    all.textContent = "All artists";
    artistEl.appendChild(all);
    names.forEach((name) => {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = name;
      opt.textContent = `${name} (${counts.get(name)})`;
      artistEl.appendChild(opt);
    });
  };

  const render = () => {
    const needle = searchEl.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const artist = artistEl.value;
    const filtered = tracks.filter((t) => {
      const artists = splitArtists(t.artists);
      const artistOk = !artist || artists.includes(artist);
      const searchOk =
        !needle ||
        t.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
        t.artists.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
      return artistOk && searchOk;
    });

    listEl.replaceChildren();
    filtered.forEach((t, i) => {
      const row = document.createElement("button");
      row.type = "button";
      row.className = "sp-row" + (t.id === activeId ? " active" : "");
      row.dataset.id = t.id;
      row.innerHTML = `
        <span class="sp-num">${i + 1}</span>
        <span>
          <div class="sp-title"></div>
          <div class="sp-artists"></div>
        </span>
        <span class="sp-dur">${fmtDur(t.duration_ms)}</span>
      `;
      row.querySelector(".sp-title").textContent = t.title;

      const artistsEl = row.querySelector(".sp-artists");
      const names = splitArtists(t.artists);
      if (!names.length) {
        artistsEl.textContent = t.artists || "";
      } else {
        names.forEach((name, idx) => {
          if (idx) artistsEl.appendChild(document.createTextNode(", "));
          const btn = document.createElement("button");
          btn.type = "button";
          btn.className = "sp-artist-link";
          btn.textContent = name;
          btn.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            artistEl.value = name;
            render();
          });
          artistsEl.appendChild(btn);
        });
      }

      row.addEventListener("click", () => playTrack(t));
      listEl.appendChild(row);
    });

    emptyEl.hidden = filtered.length > 0;
    const filtering = Boolean(needle || artist);
    countEl.textContent = filtering
      ? `${filtered.length} / ${tracks.length} songs`
      : `${tracks.length} songs`;
  };

  try {
    const res = await fetch("assets/spotify/playlist.json", { cache: "no-store" });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    tracks = (data.tracks || []).filter((t) => !t.local);

    const cover = document.getElementById("sp-cover");
    if (data.cover) {
      cover.src = data.cover;
      cover.alt = data.name || "Playlist cover";
    } else {
      cover.hidden = true;
    }
    document.getElementById("sp-name").textContent = data.name || "Playlist";
    const owner = data.owner ? `by ${data.owner}` : "";
    const updated = data.updated
      ? ` · updated ${data.updated.slice(0, 10)}`
      : "";
    document.getElementById("sp-meta").textContent = `${owner}${updated}`.replace(/^ · /, "");
    if (data.url) document.getElementById("sp-open").href = data.url;

    populateArtists();
    render();
    searchEl.addEventListener("input", render);
    artistEl.addEventListener("change", render);
  } catch (err) {
    root.innerHTML = `<p class="sp-empty">Could not load playlist data.</p>`;
    console.error(err);
  }
})();
</script>
```
